references.text: The Lord is a protector of the foreigner; he upholds the fatherless and the widow, but he makes the way of the wicked crooked
Is it not to share your bread with the hungry, and bring the homeless poor into your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him, and not hide yourself from your own flesh?
Do not forget hospitality; for by it some have entertained angels without knowing it
Pure and undefiled religion before God and the Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their affliction, to keep oneself unstained by the world
But if anyone has the world's goods and sees his brother in need, yet closes his heart against him, how does God's love abide in him?
